**CSM notes, Daniel Ohlsson, 2026-08-27:**

Måltidsfabriken. Robert opened by telling me plainly that his budget is under pressure and that the account has nothing left to talk about now the scorecard is answered. He has found a real next step himself, the supplier module, and wants a scoped version at roughly a third to a half of full price, covering his top five suppliers rather than all fifteen.

His reasoning is sound. Their footprint is almost entirely raw material on category averages, and he can see supplier level data becoming a live question even though no customer has asked yet. His target for year one is realistic: data from five or six of fifteen suppliers, not full coverage.

I told him I would check on a scoped package and come back within a week. Raised it with commercial the same afternoon. **Declined** on Thursday. There is no scoped supplier module product, and the answer was that building one for a single nineteen thousand euro amber account does not make commercial sense, even though the account is exactly the shape the expansion motion is supposed to work on: a customer who has found a genuine second use case on their own, asking for less rather than more.

I have not told Robert yet. I am recording it here first because I want to think about how to say it, and because I think this is a bigger problem than one account. He asked me directly on the call whether this was something we actually wanted to sell or whether I was being polite about something that made no commercial sense, and I told him I would find out and tell him honestly. The honest answer is closer to his second guess than I would like.

If I tell him no with nothing else, he has told me himself he will spend August through November looking for a different renewal argument rather than fighting for this one, and I do not have one to offer him. Renewal is 9 December, flagged amber, and this was the best chance I have seen on this account to make it more than amber.

Flagging for review: the account most eligible for a small structured expansion motion is exactly the shape of account the current pricing has no product for.
